title: Parse a CSV Row
prompt: Write parse_row(line) that takes one CSV line like name,age,city and returns a dict with keys name (str), age (int), city (str).

tests.name: parses one row
tests.code:
assert parse_row("minh,21,Hanoi") == {"name": "minh", "age": 21, "city": "Hanoi"}, f"got {parse_row(chr(109)+chr(105)+chr(110)+chr(104)+chr(44)+chr(50)+chr(49)+chr(44)+chr(72)+chr(97)+chr(110)+chr(111)+chr(105))}"
assert parse_row("lan,19,Danang")["age"] == 19, "age must be an int"
tests.hint: parts = line.split(","); return {"name": parts[0], "age": int(parts[1]), "city": parts[2]}
